title: Johnny Brown, the Maple Leaf players and counting a drummer as two pieces
summary: They try to pin down Johnny Brown's band and the Maple Leaf lineup, and Rene explains union counting of drum pieces.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
